title: FieldFix Fault-Tree Entry
description: Structured fault-tree entry consumed by the on-device Local RAG store. Produced hand-curated for seed data and by the cloud Distillation Agent on sync. Schema matches ARCHITECTURE.md §3.3.

fault_id.description: Unique lowercase snake_case identifier. Must match the file name (without .json).

equipment_type.description: Class of equipment this entry applies to.

symptoms.description: Short symptom phrases used for keyword/vector lookup against SymptomInput.

hypotheses.description: Ordered list of candidate hypotheses. The reasoning loop iterates through these, ruling each out based on CHECK results.

name.description: Machine-readable hypothesis name in snake_case. Used in SessionState.ruled_out_hypotheses.

diagnostic_step.description: Concrete action for the technician to perform to test this hypothesis.

expected_result.description: Measurable / observable outcome that would confirm the hypothesis. Should include units or clear qualitative markers.

if_confirmed.description: Fix or remedial action if the hypothesis is confirmed.

if_ruled_out.description: Next hypothesis or diagnostic path if the observed result does not match expected_result.

safety_flags.description: Safety-critical keywords/phrases. Presence of any of these in technician input triggers the DEFER path per ARCHITECTURE.md §3.2.
